api_card.text: You can set an "addToHistory" metadata property of false on a transaction to prevent it from being rolled back by undo.

example_card.location: allows changes not part of history; selected first capture-preservation example; exact source lines83-86
example_card.text:
state = type(state, "hello")
    state = state.apply(state.tr.insertText("oops", 1).setMeta("addToHistory", false))
    state = state.apply(state.tr.insertText("!", 10).setMeta("addToHistory", false))
    state = command(state, undo)

api_card.text: This is a command that will undo an input rule, if applying such a rule was the last thing that the user did.

example_card.location: tracks multiple levels of history; first group-relevant test; inputrules package has no tests; exact source lines52-57
example_card.text:
state = type(state, "a")
    state = type(state, "b")
    state = state.apply(state.tr.insertText("c", 1))
    ist(state.doc, doc(p("cab")), eq)
    state = command(state, undo)
    ist(state.doc, doc(p("ab")), eq)
